coming-soon-flips-a.summary: A coming soon teaser on tangerine and navy plates. Condensed cream or navy words hard cut one at a time, HOLD YOUR BREATH WHAT'S NEXT IS LANDING, each with a short bar growing under it, and the second BREATH stutters through serif, marker, brush and thin typefaces. After a two frame flash of a pale blue plaster wall, an outlined ALMOST over a solid tangerine HERE flickers on letter by letter and tracks in at the top while two soft diagonal slats of window light sweep up the wall across the logo and name, leave the wall, swing back in, then open into one pool that rests on the logo and name.

magnifier-caption-c.variantNote: Keeps the layout and the search, but every found word lifts out of the lens and flies up into its place in the caption, so the eye is led from the find to the line each time instead of jumping between two places, with round cells and a warm Fraunces caption on deep green.
magnifier-caption-c.concept: A magnifying glass searches a blurred honeycomb of stray words; each word it finds lights up inside the lens and joins a caption at the top, one word at a time, until the last word, the keyword, glows in the accent colour and is marked. The eye follows the lens and reads the message as it is found, with the brand waiting below. Thoughtful, calm and a little mysterious.

Headline.hint: The caption the lens finds one word at a time, best as one sentence of 4 to 10 words; the last word is the keyword, so end on the word that matters

Logo.hint: Logo: wide, square or round; it sits on a plate under the magnifier

Company Name.hint: Brand name under the logo; long names shrink to one line

samples.Headline: Every answer shows up for those who keep searching

phone-spin-in-a.summary: On a light off-white studio, a titanium phone showing your app rises from below the frame nearly edge-on, makes one quarter turn toward the camera as it climbs and lands on the right third, turned slightly toward the copy. As it lands, your logo, a bold two or three line headline and your website with a round arrow button rise in one after another on the left, then everything holds with a gentle float.

beats.what: the phone's edge pushes up from the bottom of an empty off-white studio, tipped back and leaning
it rises and turns a quarter turn toward the camera, sliding in from the right as the screen wakes
the logo fades up on the left while the phone is still settling
the headline rises in line by line
the website arrives with a round arrow button in the Primary color
the phone lands on the right third, slightly turned toward the copy
the finished frame holds with a gentle float, sway and camera drift

phone-spin-in-a.variantNote: Closest to the inspiration: the same studio, phone, rise and quarter turn, but it lands on the right third so the logo, a short headline and the website can arrive on the left while it settles, and it ends on that finished frame instead of fading to black, so the whole clip says whose app it is.
phone-spin-in-a.concept: One premium phone rises out of the bottom of the frame with a single quarter turn and lands facing the viewer, so the app screen becomes the hero in one calm move, while the logo, a short headline and the website arrive around it as it settles to say whose app it is. Quiet studio, one object, warm and confident copy.

Screen.hint: A portrait screenshot of the app (about 9 by 19.5); it fills the phone screen from the top and crops any extra

Logo.hint: Logo: wide, square or round; it sits above the headline on the left

Headline.hint: One short line on what the app does; it wraps to up to three lines beside the phone and shrinks if longer

Website.hint: Where to get the app, set small as the call to action near the logo and headline
